pages.name: Akaishi Miner (9x9x3)
pages.text: The controller sits at the center of the middle layer. The bottom and top layers each have one port (2 total). U slots can be swapped for upgrade-module blocks.

$(2,4)Build tips$(0)$(li)9×9 cross-section × 3 layers tall$(li)Place the controller at the middle-layer center first, then fill in the rest$(li)Upgrade-frame slots U: put empty upgrade frames or install upgrade modules directly$(li)Put 1 port P at the center of both the top and bottom layers$(br2)Once formed, the controller broadcasts to the ports and produced minerals auto-flow into the port buffers. Get the positions right and the miner "spits ore" on its own.
